The Ridgeville Corners branch is our full-service agronomy location. Ridgeville Agronomy offers anhydrous ammonia, liquid & dry fertilizer, bulk & packaged crop protection products, custom seed treating, field scouting, tissue sampling, along with custom application of dry and liquid products. We also handle a wide range of seed corn, soybeans, wheat, & forage products from Beck's Hybrids. Our Ridgeville Corners Agronomy branch is also proudly 4R Nutrient Stewardship Certified.

Archbold branch is a grain handling facility and home to GGC FEEDS, LLC. This facility has tripled it grain receiving speed, doubled its wet corn holding capabilities, and added a half million grain storage bin. GGC FEEDS focus is providing custom formulation to integrator as well as hobby farmers. This branch is home to all your Provimi (Akey), Kalmbach, and Purina/Land O Lakes feeds, along with all animal feed needs.
